smoke_test.prompt: Compare the bundled synthetic Q3 and Q2 win/loss patterns.

stands_in_for: a sales system that records closed deals as won or lost, with a reason
needs: closed deals: name, value, won or lost, the reason recorded at close, close date
won versus lost: how many and how much
lost deals grouped by the recorded reason

systems.rule: Won and lost come from each deal's status. The reason is the status reason recorded when the deal was closed.
systems.preview: <fetch aggregate="true"><entity name="opportunity"><attribute name="opportunityid" alias="deals" aggregate="count"/><attribute name="statecode" alias="outcome" groupby="true"/><filter><condition attribute="statecode" operator="in"><value>1</value><value>2</value></condition></filter></entity></fetch>
systems.test_question: How are we doing on wins and losses?

win_loss_overview.when: won versus lost, counts and value; the second query returns the combined total
queries: <fetch aggregate="true"><entity name="opportunity"><attribute name="opportunityid" alias="deals" aggregate="count"/><attribute name="estimatedvalue" alias="estimated_value" aggregate="sum"/><attribute name="actualvalue" alias="actual_value" aggregate="sum"/><attribute name="statecode" alias="outcome" groupby="true"/><filter><condition attribute="statecode" operator="in"><value>1</value><value>2</value></condition></filter></entity></fetch>

<fetch aggregate="true"><entity name="opportunity"><attribute name="opportunityid" alias="deals" aggregate="count"/><attribute name="estimatedvalue" alias="estimated_value" aggregate="sum"/><attribute name="actualvalue" alias="actual_value" aggregate="sum"/><filter><condition attribute="statecode" operator="in"><value>1</value><value>2</value></condition></filter></entity></fetch>

root_cause_analysis.when: why deals were lost, by recorded reason
queries: <fetch aggregate="true"><entity name="opportunity"><attribute name="opportunityid" alias="deals" aggregate="count"/><attribute name="estimatedvalue" alias="estimated_value" aggregate="sum"/><attribute name="statuscode" alias="reason" groupby="true"/><filter><condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="2"/></filter></entity></fetch>

<fetch top="10"><entity name="opportunity"><attribute name="name"/><attribute name="estimatedvalue"/><attribute name="statuscode"/><attribute name="actualclosedate"/><order attribute="estimatedvalue" descending="true"/><filter><condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="2"/></filter></entity></fetch>
